overview_description.description: SODA launched its customer-to-customer marketplace SNKRDUNK, which now has over 6 million monthly users in Japan. Through the platform, users can buy and sell sneakers, streetwear and collectibles safely as it offers legitimacy checking services through local authentication provider Fake Busters.
